intro.title:
A house with character,
in the heart of Estoril
paragraphs: Casa da Penha is a traditional Portuguese house in the centre of Estoril, designed to welcome guests in a warm, carefully kept and authentic setting. We have worked to preserve the character of the house, celebrating its traditional features, its welcoming décor and its connection to the local area.
Our idea is to offer a stay with a Portuguese identity — comfortable and discreet, equally suited to leisure breaks and to longer stays.

roomsIntro.title: Every room, its own atmosphere
roomsIntro.lede: Terracotta, bamboo green and whitewashed white — every space in the house was designed with the same care and the same serene palette.

garden.title: A garden made for living outdoors
garden.text: Lawn, pine trees, oleanders and a wooden deck for al fresco meals — the garden at Casa da Penha invites you to slow down, between the greenery and the light of Estoril.

location.title: Estoril: history, elegance and seaside living
paragraphs: Estoril is one of the most iconic places on the Portuguese Riviera. Its reputation as a cosmopolitan destination grew in the early 20th century with the development of the Costa do Sol, Casino Estoril, the grand hotels and its closeness to the sea — a sophisticated, discreet atmosphere that remains part of the region's identity today.

Staying in the centre of Estoril means being surrounded by this historic setting, with easy access to culture, leisure, sport and the sea. The coastal train line offers a direct connection to Lisbon, with no need for a car.
The area is also known for its strong sporting tradition: golf courses, tennis clubs, Cascais Marina and the Estoril Circuit make it especially appealing for anyone who values sport and leisure.
